programme.title: Barbara Hannigan at Severance Hall

programme.title: Brahms - Klavierquartett Nr. 3 in c-Moll, Op. 60

programme.title: Dvorák - Sinfonie Nr. 8 in G-Dur, op. 88

programme.title: Prokofjew - Peter und der Wolf

programme.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10

programme.desc: Violinist Daniel Rowland, violist Rachel Roberts, cellist Julian Arp, and pianist Diana Ketler perform Richard Strauss' 'Piano Quartet in C minor, Op. 13', as part of the Stiftfestival 2016 in the Dutch village of Weerselo.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Dialogue between Zubin Mehta and the musicians as they explore Strauss' tone poem together.

programme.title: Grieg, Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Filmed in April 1975 at Croydon's Fairfield Hall. Rubinstein is at his warm-hearted, lyrical best.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Orff: Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Música del Palacio de Minería in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are soprano Anabel de la Mora, tenor Andrés Carrillo and baritone Daniel Cerón.

programme.title: Who Stole the Bolero by Maurice Ravel
programme.desc: An investigation into perhaps one of the most played pieces of music in the world. A phenomenal success, leading to covers, questions concerning rights and legal disputes.

programme.title: Who Stole the Bolero by Maurice Ravel
programme.desc: An investigation into perhaps one of the most played pieces of music in the world. A phenomenal success, leading to covers, questions concerning rights and legal disputes.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Schumann
programme.desc: In recent years, a new generation of Chinese pianists has emerged on the international scene. But there are many more young Chinese artists, who the Académie France-Chine aims to enable to deepen their art by introducing them.

programme.title: Beethoven, Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93
programme.desc: Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 8 with the Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Herbert von Karajan.

programme.title: Gara Garayev: Autumn Sonatas
programme.desc: Violinist Vadim Repin and pianist Murad Hüseynov perform Gara Garayev's 'Violin Sonata and 24 Preludes for Piano'. Murad represents a character carried by solitude and found in the romantic paintings of Friedrich.

programme.title: Chamber Music by Mozart and Shostakovich
programme.desc: French violinist Renaud Capuçon appears at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, presenting chamber music consisting of classical and 20th century repertoire. He performs with the soloists of the International Menuhin Music Academy.

programme.title: Strauss' Metamorphosen & Mozart's Requiem
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra and Chorus in a concert performing Richard Strauss' `Metamorphosen' and Mozart's `Requiem, K. 626'. Soloists are Siobhan Stagg and Avery Amereau.

programme.title: Mahler, Symphony No. 3 in D minor
programme.desc: Bernarda Fink, Breda Boys' Choir, Rijnmond Boys' Choir, Netherlands Radio Choir.

programme.title: Ueda - Someone Out There is Praying for Peace III
programme.desc: Italian conductor Andrea Vitello leads Ensemble BIOS in a performance of `Someone Out There is Praying for Peace (Let Us Not Be the Reason), III', by contemporary Canadian composer Rita Ueda, at Chiesa di San Cristo in Brescia, Italy.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at the 2020 Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at the 2020 Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven's celebrated Symphony No 3 in E-flat major, Op 55, Eroica.

programme.title: Music in the Air
programme.desc: The Vienna-based IMZ International Music + Media Centre, a global association, celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2015. Shedding light on the history of classical music. Featuring footage of Arturo Toscanini conducting the NBC Symphony Orchestra.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pay tribute to the music of Vienna in a 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble consists of musicians from the Vienna and Berlin Philharmonic performing five waltzes from Johann Strauss II.

programme.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from multiple Oscar-winning movies such as The Lord of the Ring, Game of Thrones, The Chronicles of Narnia and Harry Potter. Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Bernard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic in a rendition of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 4 in the Schauspielhaus in Berlin, in 1992. Soloist is soprano Sylvia McNair.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices
programme.desc: A look at 'The Legacy of Farinelli' and following the history of castrati in choral music: male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range.

programme.title: Fauré: Requiem
programme.desc: Under the baton of conductor Conrad van Alphen, Sinfonia Rotterdam and the Laurenscantorij join forces for a wonderful performance of Gabriel Fauré's popular 'Requiem'.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, op. 26
programme.desc: Schwarz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna). Schumann composed most of the work during his stay in Vienna in 1839, where he wrote the first four movements.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 & 111
programme.desc: Beethoven's last three sonatas explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. Director Mariano Nante explores them, setting pianist Alexandre Tharaud in a film inspired by the universe of Tarkovsky.

programme.title: Glass: Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass' Concerto for Two Pianos with the Orchestre de Paris.

programme.title: CMIM
programme.desc: Pianist Arisa Onoda joins the CMIM ensemble, consisting of three principal string players of the Montreal Symphony Orchestra, in a performance of the first movement, 'Allegro molto moderato', of Gabriel Fauré's Piano Quartet No 1 in C minor, Op 15.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: A portrait of the composer Charles Ives. Ives was among the first American composers to achieve international acclaim. Born in 1874, he experimented with advanced features including polytonality, twelve-tone technique, and quarter tones.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G Minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: The celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz presents Schumann's `Piano Sonata No 2 in G minor, Op. 22'. Of Schumann's three piano sonatas, it is the work performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energising concert pieces featuring a range of artists.

programme.title: Mahler: Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: Bernhard Haitink conducts the Berlin Philharmonic and the Ernst Senff Choir in a performance of Gustav Mahler's Symphony No. 2 at the Berliner Philharmonie in 1992.

programme.title: Clara Haskil : le mystère de l'interprète
programme.desc: Charlie Chaplin considered her a genius. Clara Haskil was undeniably a brilliant pianist, an enchanting, fluid, poetic performer able to captivate an audience like no other artist.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia

programme.title: Invisible World: WOMEX 2018

programme.title: Ivan Gomes & Lucibela Freitas Dos Santos: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria; one of its showcase participants, Lucibela, comes from the island of São Nicolau; her assured, warm voice is formed from years of assimilation of the sounds of morna and coladera.

programme.title: Kim So Ra: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Traditional percussionist/composer Kim So Ra performs at WOMEX 2018, in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Armin Van Buuren: This Is Me

programme.title: Salomao Soares Trio - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Salomão Soares Trio consists of Salomão Soares on piano, Paulo Almeida on drums and Thiago Alves on bass; band leader is Soares, who was a finalist of the 2017 Montreux Jazz Festival piano competition.

programme.title: Moonlight Benjamin: WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Musical artist Moonlight Benjamin performs at WOMEX 2018.

programme.title: Da Pá Virada Sessions: Amilton Godoy
programme.desc: Presenting the musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz and beyond; Brazilian pianist Amilton Godoy is considered one of today's greatest pianists, often guesting with international top orchestras and conductors.

programme.title: Null + Void
programme.desc: Null + Void performs at the 2018 Sónar Reykjavík Festival.

programme.title: Giana Viscardi & Gustavo Marques - New Year's Eve Special
programme.desc: Da Pá Virada Sessions and Stingray present Giana Viscardi and Gustavo Marques; arranged by Letieres Leite, conductor of the Orchestra Rumpilezz.

programme.title: Pete Doherty & Frederic Lo Live at Le Trianon

programme.title: Fuá do Guegué
programme.desc: Curated by its percussionist and leader, Guegué Medeiros, the collective Fuá Do Guegué aims to bring together professionals and artists who identify with and value the rhythms, characteristics, and art of Brazil's Northeast.

programme.title: Mario Batkovic: WOMEX 2018
